rot.convert.demos.semCorte.1: Defence: now let us think from Black's side. In a position like the one in the idea, White brought the king to c5 without cutting off the black king.
rot.convert.demos.semCorte.2: Defence: the black king comes to e6, reaches the pawn and attacks it.
rot.convert.demos.semCorte.3: Attack: the white king goes to c6 and protects the pawn.
rot.convert.demos.semCorte.4: Defence: the black rook checks on c2 and drives the white king away from the pawn.
rot.convert.demos.semCorte.5: Attack: the white king steps out of check via b7, but the pawn is left unprotected.
rot.convert.demos.semCorte.6: Defence: the black king captures the pawn: rook against rook is a draw. That is why the rook cuts off the black king before the escort.
rot.convert.demos.xeque.1: Attack: now the black king is already on e6, right next to the pawn. See how to cut it off anyway.
rot.convert.demos.xeque.2: Attack: the rook goes to e1 and cuts off with check: the black king must leave the e-file, and the pawn stays protected by your king. It is the only winning move.
rot.convert.demos.xeque.3: Defence: the black king steps out of check to f6, but stays on the other side of the e-file.
rot.convert.demos.xeque.4: Attack: the king goes to c7, beside the pawn.
rot.convert.demos.xeque.5: Defence: the black rook goes to c2 and checks, to drive your king away from the pawn.
rot.convert.demos.xeque.6: Attack: the king steps into d8, in front of the pawn, where the black rook cannot check along the d-file.
rot.convert.demos.xeque.7: Defence: the black rook goes to a2, far from your king.
rot.convert.demos.xeque.8: Attack: the pawn reaches d7: this is the Lucena position, with the black king cut off. Now comes the bridge.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.e1: Attack: the pawn is on d6, your king on c4, and the black king, on f7, is not cut off yet: it threatens to go to e6, right next to the pawn. Before the escort, the rook cuts off the black king.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l1: Attack: the rook goes to e1 and cuts off the black king on the e-file. It is the only winning move: without the cut, the black king gets close to the pawn, and it is a draw.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l2: Defence: the black rook goes to a2, on the other side of the board, from where it checks your king.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l3: Attack: the king goes to c5 and starts the escort, right next to the pawn.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l4: Defence: the black rook goes to d2 and attacks the pawn from behind.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l5: Attack: the king goes to c6, protects the pawn and keeps going up beside it.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.e1: Attack: the king protects the pawn from c6. Now it must reach d8, in front of the pawn, without moving away from it.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l1: Defence: the black rook goes to c2 and starts the checks, to drive your king away from the pawn.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l2: Attack: the king steps out of check via b7, up one rank. The pawn is unprotected for one move, but your king protects it again before the black rook can capture it.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l3: Defence: the black rook goes to b2 and keeps checking, now along the b-file.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l4: Attack: the king goes to c7 and protects the pawn again, one rank higher.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l5: Defence: the black rook returns to c2, one more check along the c-file.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l6: Attack: the king steps into d8, in front of the pawn. Along the d-file the black rook cannot check: the pawn is in the way.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l7: Defence: the black rook goes to a2, far from your king, from where it can check along the eighth rank.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l8: Attack: the pawn reaches d7, on the seventh rank, with your king in front of it. This is the Lucena position.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.e1: Attack: in the Lucena position, building the bridge is all that is left. But the black king is on f7, close to the pawn.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l1: Defence: the black rook goes to c2 and shuts the c-file. With the black king watching e7 and e8, your king is stuck on d8.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l10: Attack: the king goes to e6 and leaves the d-file, still beside the pawn.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l11: Defence: the black rook returns to e2, one more check along the e-file.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l12: Attack: the king goes to d5, just above the fourth rank.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l13: Defence: the black rook returns to d2, one more check along the d-file.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l14: Attack: the rook goes to d4 and blocks the check, protected by the king: the bridge is built, and the checks are over.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l15: Defence: the black rook goes to f2: with no check and no way to stop the promotion, it just waits.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l16: Attack: the pawn promotes on d8, and the queen wins the game. Cut off, escort, reach the Lucena position and build the bridge: that is the whole road.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l2: Attack: the rook checks from f1, drives the black king away and cuts it off on the f-file. Now your king can get out via e7.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l3: Defence: the black king steps out of check to g7. With the rook on the f-file, it cannot come back near the pawn.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l4: Attack: the rook goes to f4 and prepares the bridge: on the fourth rank, it will block the checks later on.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l5: Defence: the black king goes to g6, closer to the rook: from g5, it would attack it.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l6: Attack: the king goes to e7 and steps out of the pawn's way, and the pawn now threatens to promote.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l7: Defence: the black rook goes to e2 and starts the checks along the e-file.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l8: Attack: the king comes down to d6, towards the rook, and keeps protecting the pawn.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l9: Defence: the black rook goes to d2, check along the d-file.
rot.convert.pratica.err.ataque.1: After that move, the black rook attacks the pawn, and Black holds the draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.ataque.2: During the escort, the king climbs right next to the pawn, to protect it from the black rook.
rot.convert.pratica.err.colunaD.1: The black rook goes to the d-file, and your rook can no longer cut off the black king there: Black holds the draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.colunaD.2: Bring the rook to the d-file, between the black king and the pawn, and keep it there until the Lucena position.
rot.convert.pratica.err.menor.1: The pawn became a bishop or a knight, and rook and minor piece against rook is usually a draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.menor.2: When you promote, choose the queen.
rot.convert.pratica.err.peao.1: The black rook captures the pawn, and Black holds the draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.peao.2: Before each move, check whether the black rook can capture the pawn. If it can, protect the pawn or promote.
rot.convert.pratica.err.pendurada.1: Your rook was within reach of the black king, and the move did not take it away: the king captures it, and it is a draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.pendurada.2: Before each move, check whether the black king attacks your rook. If it does, take care of it first.
rot.convert.pratica.err.perdeR.1: The black king captures your rook: with only the pawn against the rook, the game is lost.
rot.convert.pratica.err.perdeR.2: Before each rook move, check whether the black king reaches the new square.
rot.convert.pratica.err.perdeT.1: The black rook captures your rook: with only the pawn against the rook, the game is lost.
rot.convert.pratica.err.perdeT.2: Before each rook move, check whether the black rook reaches the new square.
rot.convert.pratica.err.reiPerto.1: The rook went next to the black king, which attacks it and gains time: Black holds the draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.reiPerto.2: Before each rook move, check whether the black king reaches the new square.
rot.convert.pratica.err.reiPreto.1: Without your rook on the d-file, the black king steps onto it, close to the pawn, and Black holds the draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.reiPreto.2: Bring the rook to the d-file, between the black king and the pawn, and keep it there until the Lucena position.
rot.convert.pratica.err.semCorte.1: Without your rook on the d-file, the black king is not cut off, and Black holds the draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.semCorte.2: Before escorting the pawn, cut off the black king with the rook on the d-file, between it and the pawn.
rot.convert.pratica.err.tapaPeao.1: Your rook went in front of the pawn and took its promotion square: Black holds the draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.tapaPeao.2: With the pawn on the seventh rank, keep the promotion square free.
rot.convert.pratica.err.trocaR.1: The black king captures your rook: with only the pawn against the rook, it is a draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.trocaR.2: Before each rook move, check whether the black king reaches the new square.
rot.convert.pratica.err.trocaT.1: The black rook captures your rook: with only the pawn against the rook, it is a draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.trocaT.2: Before each rook move, check whether the black rook reaches the new square.
rot.convert.pratica.err.xequeTorre.1: The rook was left within reach of the black king: after the black rook's check, the king captures it, and the game is lost.
rot.convert.pratica.err.xequeTorre.2: Before each rook move, check whether the black king reaches the new square.
rot.convert.pratica.fins.afogado: The black king is stalemated: a draw. Before each move, check that Black still has a move.
rot.convert.pratica.fins.insuficiente: The rook and the pawn left the board, and the material is not enough: a draw. Keep the pawn and the rook protected until the promotion.
rot.convert.pratica.fins.limite: Practice time ran out before the pawn promoted. Cut off the black king, go up with the king right next to the pawn and, in the Lucena position, build the bridge.
rot.convert.pratica.fins.repeticao: The same position came up three times: a draw. Instead of running from the checks, go up with the king right next to the pawn.
rot.convert.pratica.sozinho.fim: The pawn promoted: you cut off the black king, escorted the pawn to the Lucena position and built the bridge.
rot.convert.pratica.sozinho.p: Attack: White again, now on your own, from start to finish. The pawn is on e5, your king on f4, and the black king, on c7, is not cut off yet. Cut it off, escort the pawn and promote.
